verdict.rationale: Solid's own repository says performant state management is built in through Context and Stores, so no third-party library is needed for global state. That makes it a first-party solution maintained with the framework itself, backed by fine-grained reactive state with automatic dependency tracking. A long-term user also reports that its state changes stay intuitive and easy to debug. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the Store API (nested updates, mutation helpers), evidence on how it scales in large apps, and independent hands-on corroboration that names Stores specifically.
